body:
A reflection for tonight:
→ name three blessings before you sleep
→ thank one person who helped you this week
→ use a blessing well: time, health, money

claims.text: What quran:14:7 says, quoted verbatim on screen.
Naming blessings, thanking people and using blessings well are ways to act on the ayah.
